summary_md: **Stan Fossum ([@stanfossum](https://x.com/stanfossum/status/2115423103971127511))** points to Google Research's **sleep framework**, which gives an LLM a "sleep" phase to consolidate new facts into long-term memory while limiting forgetting, and asks who decides what deployed models remember.

referenced_urls.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning

relevance: Continual-learning consolidation relevant to long-lived agents.

media.description: Illustration in an embroidered-textile style: patchwork squares with leaves, stars and waves being woven into a quilt on a wooden loom at night, a metaphor for consolidating memories.
